row.notes: Null text returns 0. Scans six ints from text with the format at 0x145892b00 (0x1401dbdc0); on exactly 6 it builds a tm-style struct (year-1900, month-1), converts with 0x14534d1f4 and stores the result at out+0 unless it is -1, then copies up to 24 chars of text into the inline string at out+0x20 (data ptr out+0x18, capacity 0x19 at out+0x10). Returns whether 6 fields were parsed. Callers pass a JSON string value and keep only out+0: Game_Standings_WriteDriversPointsList for two date members of a record (+0x168/+0x170), Game_F1osVote_ApplyEventResponse for the question date (obj+0x30), 0x14287be60 (JSON field handler that stores the time at [self+8]+0x55f8 and sets byte +0x5600).
